title: WHITE CLAW — THE OFFICE
lessons: The player sees a 2026 promotion where White Claw opened a large bar tab around basketball tournament viewing to change habitual drink orders.
The player already knows which White Claw line they want and uses the brand site to find it nearby or order delivery where available.

text: The player sees a 2026 promotion where White Claw opened a large bar tab around basketball tournament viewing to change habitual drink orders.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You paid part of the first round?

entry-first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: In participating places, yes.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: That sounds generous until I remember you want me to switch what I order.

entry-first-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Correct. It was a promotion. Lower the cost of trying something else and habitual orders get a little less automatic.

choice-first.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I would try something new if the promotion covered it.
A free drink is a very direct way to buy trial.
I do not want an alcohol brand using sports to push one more round.

first-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then the incentive did its job and the product still has to earn the next order.

first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Correct. I paid to make trying me easier. I still wanted the next order.

first-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then keep your usual order.

first-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Even on your tab?

first-3-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: The promotion lowers the barrier. It does not confiscate your free will.
The player already knows which White Claw line they want and uses the brand site to find it nearby or order delivery where available.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I know exactly which one I want and nobody nearby seems to have it.

entry-return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: That is when I stop being a personality and become a locator.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Finally.

entry-return-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Find it nearby or use delivery where available. No need to make scarcity romantic.

choice-return.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like not driving around looking for one flavor.
Convenience can make the purchase too automatic.
If I cannot find it easily, I will buy something else.

return-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then availability is part of loyalty for you.

return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Yes. Removing friction is good business and can also remove a pause in the decision.

return-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then do not drive across town for me.
